review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked the simp status of psl2zToPSL2R_smul, sl2zToPSL2R_smul and pslMk_smul in TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/UpperHalfPlane/PSL/Action.lean, and Mathlib's Subgroup.smul_def. Only one real simp-interface weakness turned up: the action of an element of a bundled subgroup of PSL(2, ℝ) has no simp lemma, so the same unfolding is rewritten by hand at many call sites. I did not recommend simp attributes on the elliptic-order lemmas, the stabilizer-card equalities or the `if` statements. Those are not canonical rewrites and would be bad simp lemmas. I could not run Lean, so I cannot say whether the proposed lemma would fire or close the goals in every one of these call sites. Orientation and termination of the proposed lemma look safe, because its right-hand side is an SL/PSL(2, ℤ) action.

findings.problem: No simp lemma says how an element of the bundled subgroup `psl2zToPSL2R.range` (or `Γ.map sl2zToPSL2R`) acts on `ℍ`. Mathlib's `Subgroup.smul_def` is not simp. Every proof therefore unfolds the action by hand with the same combination of `Subgroup.smul_def`, `MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply` and `psl2zToPSL2R_smul` (or `sl2zToPSL2R_smul`). The combination is written as `simp only` at lines 86 and 104, as non-terminal `simpa [Subgroup.smul_def, …]` at lines 116 and 119, and as `rw` chains at lines 188 and 203. It recurs in `Action.lean` and `ModularInvariant.lean`. The rewrite is not part of the simp set, so each new proof about stabilizers or orbits of the effective group must rediscover the lemma list. The `simpa` calls at 116 and 119 also depend on whatever else is simp.
findings.proposed_change: Add one simp lemma next to `psl2zToPSL2R_smul` in `Action.lean`. It would state that the action of the range-subgroup element built from `g : PSL(2, ℤ)` (that is, `MonoidHom.ofInjective psl2zToPSL2R_injective g`) on `τ` equals `g • τ`. A second lemma would do the same for `Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem`-style elements `⟨sl2zToPSL2R g, _⟩ : Γ.map sl2zToPSL2R`, sending the action to `g • τ`. Its right-hand side contains no subgroup coercion, so it cannot loop. Then replace the hand-written `simp only` lists at lines 86 and 104, and the `Subgroup.smul_def` plus `sl2zToPSL2R_smul` rewrites at 188 and 203, with `simp` (or the single lemma). Do not mark `Subgroup.smul_def` itself simp; that is a global change.
findings.benefit: The projective-image proofs would share one canonical normal form, where an action by the effective group's subgroup elements reduces to the `PSL(2, ℤ)` or `SL(2, ℤ)` action. The `simp only` lists and non-terminal `simpa` calls would shrink or become robust. Stabilizer and orbit reasoning for `Γ.map sl2zToPSL2R` would need no manual unfolding in later files.
